description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for the pre-ship 'what invisible cross-cutting controls did the AI omit?' checklist across code surfaces. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (deep single-surface skills, prose/docs edits, adversarial config review) whose vocabulary overlaps.
